name: estack
description: if you want to go fast, go deep first. estack helps you write less, but higher quality code. rigorous agent workflows you can parallelize with confidence.

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous, model-agnostic agent workflows you can parallelize with confidence.
interface.longDescription: estack is a set of rigorous agent workflow skills built around euge-mode: it matches a task to a playbook, routes to focused skills (how, why, architect, interrogate, arena, reflect, tdd, unslop), and grounds every decision in a small set of one-principle skills. The goal is to write less, but higher quality code. Model-agnostic: skills describe roles, not specific model names.
